newsitem.title: USA: Grill Concepts says new restaurant a boost.
newsitem.headline: Grill Concepts says new restaurant a boost.

text.p: Grill Concepts Inc said Thursday its newly opened Daily Grill restaurant in Irvine, Calif., to increase the company's annual sales by about 10 percent.
For 1995, the company reported sales of $20.3 million.
The restaurant opened this week, expanding the company's chain of Daily Grills to seven in southern California. Two additional Daily Grills are scheduled to open within the next six months.
The Daily Grill in Irvine is 4,600 square feet, seating 195 patrons inside and outside on a patio.
